strings.Every audit compares a relay with the pr: Every audit compares a relay with the profile of the model it claims: context window, output limit, capabilities, identity and behavioral fingerprints. Browse the profiles here and add your own models — no YAML files or editable install needed. Your entries are stored in kb.db on this machine and used by the web UI and zing check alike.
strings.Let an AI assistant research the model,: Let an AI assistant research the model, then check its answer here before it is stored.
strings.Paste it into the AI assistant of your c: Paste it into the AI assistant of your choice. It answers with one YAML document.
strings.The check validates the schema and limit: The check validates the schema and limits, flags unsafe regular expressions, lists every prompt zing would send to relays, and shows which model ids would resolve differently. Nothing is stored until you save.

strings.Every audit compares a relay with the pr: Every audit compares a relay with the profile of the model it claims: context window, output limit, capabilities, identity and behavioral fingerprints. Here you find every model, provider and relay zing knows — packaged ones and yours — and can switch each of them on or off or add your own. Your changes are stored in kb.db on this machine and used by the web UI and zing check alike.
strings.The model profiles audits compare agains: The model profiles audits compare against. A model that is switched off no longer resolves: audits of it run without a profile.
strings.The publishers of the models: their base: The publishers of the models: their base URLs, identity and fingerprints. Switching a provider off switches off all of its models too.
strings.Endpoints without models of their own, e: Endpoints without models of their own, e.g. relays you saved on the Audit or Tools page. They are offered in the relay list there; a switched-off relay is not.
strings.A provider YAML has <code>provider</code: A provider YAML has provider, display_name, base_url_hints and models. For a provider that already exists only its models, fingerprints, base URLs and relay red flags are added.
strings.Enter a URL that starts with http:// or: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
strings.Its provider is off: audits do not use t: Its provider is off: audits do not use this model.
